description: This file defines API routes for user management in a FastAPI application, including user retrieval, creation, update, password change, registration, and deletion, with access control and email notification features.

methods.name: read_users
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users with pagination, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Create a new user and send a notification email if enabled.

methods.name: update_user_me
methods.description: Update the current user's information, ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: update_password_me
methods.description: Change the current user's password after verification.

methods.name: read_user_me
methods.description: Get details of the current user.

methods.name: delete_user_me
methods.description: Delete the current user's account unless they are a superuser.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Register a new user without authentication.

methods.name: read_user_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their ID, with access control.

methods.name: update_user
methods.description: Update user details by ID, restricted to superusers.

methods.name: delete_user
methods.description: Delete a user by ID, with safeguards against self-deletion.
